1.w: Paul, an apostle—not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, the One having raised Him out from the dead—

2.w: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:

3.w: Grace to you⁺ and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

4.w: the One having given Himself for our sins so that He might rescue us out of the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

5.w: to whom [be] the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.

6.w: I marvel that so quickly you⁺ are deserting from the One having called you⁺ in the grace of Christ to another gospel,

7.w: which is not another, except there are some who are troubling you⁺ and are wanting to pervert the gospel of Christ.

8.w: But even if we or an angel out of heaven should preach a gospel to you⁺ contrary to what we preached to you⁺, let him be accursed!

9.w: As we have said before, even now I say again: If anyone preaches a gospel [to] you⁺ contrary to what you⁺ received, let him be accursed!

10.w: For presently do I appease men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? If I were still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

11.w: For I make known to you⁺, brothers, the gospel having been preached by me, that it is not according to man.

12.w: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught [it], but through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

13.w: For you⁺ heard of my conduct formerly in Judaism, that according to excess I was persecuting the church of God and was ravaging it.

14.w: And I was advancing in Judaism beyond many contemporaries among my kindred, being more abundantly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

15.w: But when God was well pleased—the One having set me apart from the womb of my mother and having called [me] by His grace—

16.w: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I conferred not immediately with flesh and blood,

17.w: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles before me, but I went away to Arabia and returned again to Damascus.

18.w: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to make acquaintance with Cephas, and I remained with him fifteen days.

19.w: But I did not see [any] of the other apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.

20.w: Now the things I write to you⁺, behold before God that I do not lie.

21.w: Then I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

22.w: But I was unknown by face to the churches of Judea that [are] in Christ.

23.w: But they were only hearing that “the one formerly persecuting us now preaches the faith that formerly he was ravaging.”

24.w: And they were glorifying God in me.
